company.description: Matrubials is developing novel antibacterial therapeutics to address non-selectivity and emerging antimicrobial resistance. They provide safe solutions that can reduce the healthcare and economic burden resulting from bacterial infections and concomitant clinical complications. That develops the anti-pathogenic molecules from milk into therapeutics geared towards all-age diseases.
